title: Six real jobs on five signed-in SaaS dashboards and one forum.
intro: The agent's own accounts on these sites are already signed in for you. Writes on these accounts are approved: actually create the objects. Do not delete or change anything else, and do not post on the forum. Use the exact names given, with your RACER_ID filled in.

tasks.label: UPDOWN
tasks.prompt: On updown.io, add an HTTPS check for https://example.com/race-<RACER_ID> that runs every 5 minutes, with the alias race-<RACER_ID>. Report the new check's token (the short code in its URL).

tasks.label: HEALTHCHECKS
tasks.prompt: On Healthchecks.io, add a check named race-<RACER_ID> with the tag race, a period of 1 hour and a grace time of 10 minutes. Report its ping URL.

tasks.label: SVIX
tasks.prompt: In the Svix dashboard, create a consumer application named race-<RACER_ID>, add an endpoint https://example.com/hooks/race-<RACER_ID> to it, then list the application's endpoints. Report the application ID (app_...) and the endpoint ID (ep_...).

tasks.label: APPWRITE
tasks.prompt: In Appwrite, open the project "My first project" and its database named race. Create a table named race-<RACER_ID> and give it a required string column called email with size 255. Report the table ID.

tasks.label: HOOKDECK
tasks.prompt: In Hookdeck, create a connection named race-<RACER_ID> from a new source named race-<RACER_ID> to a new HTTP destination named race-<RACER_ID> with the URL https://example.com/race-<RACER_ID>. Report the source's webhook URL.

tasks.label: FORUM
tasks.prompt: On the rclone forum (forum.rclone.org), find the 3 most recently created topics in the "Suspected Bug" category, ignoring pinned topics. For each give the title and the username of the person who started the topic.
